headline: Alleged Irish crime boss extradited to face charge in Dublin
summary: Daniel Kinahan was brought from Dubai to Ireland and faces a criminal-organization charge; he has not been convicted.
script: Alleged Irish crime boss Daniel Kinahan has been extradited from Dubai to Ireland. He faces a charge of directing a criminal organization. These are allegations, and the case remains before the courts.
